svg.aria-label: How a change flows through OpenSlime: /osm:init, /osm:research, /osm:plan, /osm:impl and /osm:review. Claude is the only main loop; codex and antigravity cross-check research, plan and review, and write code in impl. Research, plan, impl and review end with a report and ledger events.
